n: James Covel, a Methodist minister for about forty years, covenanted to obey whatever the Lord would tell him through Joseph. Christ speaks as the eternal Great I AM.

f.w: from all eternity to all eternity

n: Christ is the light and life of the world, unrecognized by a darkened world.

f.w: The light and the life of the world

n: He came in the meridian of time to his own people, who rejected him.
Those who receive him gain power to become his sons — and that promise still stands.
Receiving his gospel is receiving him; rejecting it is rejecting him.

f.w: he that receiveth my gospel receiveth me

n: Christ’s gospel summarized: repentance, baptism by water, then baptism of fire and the Holy Ghost, the Comforter who reveals and teaches peace.
Christ tells James Covel that he has seen his works and knows him.
James’s heart is right at this moment, and he has been greatly blessed.

f.g: a subtle warning — his heart is right now, but his steadiness is uncertain.

n: Yet he has suffered sorrow because he rejected Christ many times out of pride and worldly concerns.

f.w: pride and the cares of the world

n: His deliverance has come: arise, be baptized, wash away sins, call on Christ’s name, and receive the Spirit and unknown blessings.

f.w: Arise and be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on my name

n: If he obeys, he’ll be prepared for a greater work: preaching the fulness of the gospel to gather Israel.
Power, great faith, and Christ’s presence will go with him.
He is called to labor in the vineyard, build the Church, and bring forth Zion.

f.w: rejoice upon the hills and flourish

n: He should go to Ohio, not to the eastern states.

f.g: the eastern United States, where Covel had previously preached.

n: God has a blessing beyond anything known in store for the Saints who gather in Ohio, and from there missionaries will go to all nations.

f.w: a blessing such as is not known among the children of men

n: The Ohio Saints pray in faith hoping God will hold back judgment on the nations, but he cannot deny his word.
Work with all your might and call faithful laborers so the vineyard can be pruned for the last time.
If people repent, accept the gospel, and become sanctified, God will hold back judgment.
Proclaim loudly that the kingdom is near, with shouts of “Hosanna!”

f.w: The kingdom of heaven is at hand

n: Baptize, preparing the way for Christ’s coming.
The time is near; no one knows the day or hour, but it will surely come.

f.w: the day or the hour no man knoweth

n: Those who receive these things receive Christ and will be gathered to him now and forever.
Those baptized should receive the Holy Ghost by laying on of hands, watch for signs of Christ’s coming, and come to know him.
Christ comes quickly.
